content: Adversarial Training. Adversarial Networks have achieved great success in computer vision such as image generation BIBREF12 , BIBREF13 . In the NLP community, the method is mainly exploited under the settings of domain adaption BIBREF14 , BIBREF7 , cross-lingual BIBREF15 , BIBREF6 and multi-task learning BIBREF16 , BIBREF17 . All these settings involve the feature divergences between the training and test examples, and aim to learn invariant features across the divergences by an additional adversarial discriminator, such as domain discriminator. Our work is similar to these work but is applies on crowdsourcing learning, aiming to find invariant features among different crowdsourcing workers.
